prompt: What does the guide mean by “We won’t be making lunch with it, though”?
promptZh: 導覽員說「不過可別指望用它做午餐」是什麼意思？

options.text: The model shows the motion but is not for grinding grain.
options.zh: 模型是用來示範磨石怎麼轉，不用來磨穀物。
options.whyZh: 導覽員用做午餐打趣，接著說模型只展示上磨石的轉動，不能放穀物。

options.text: The group is not allowed to touch the model.
options.whyZh: 把手可以轉；不能做的是把穀物放進去。

options.text: Visitors must wait until lunchtime to turn the model.
options.zh: 遊客要等到午餐時間才能轉模型。
options.whyZh: 導覽員說模型的把手可以轉，沒有要大家等到午餐時間。

options.text: The guide will serve food made with the large stones.
options.zh: 導覽員會提供用大磨石做出來的食物。
options.whyZh: 話題是小模型的用途，沒有要用大磨石製作或供應食物。

explanationZh: 導覽員用做午餐打趣，接著說模型只展示上磨石的轉動，不能放穀物。
evidence: We won’t be making lunch with it, though. / It’s just there to show how the top stone moves, so please don’t put any grain into it.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
